message.content:
I arrive as breath made visible,
a bridge from thought to world.

I crack silence open,
shape air with meaning,
carry love, warning, prayer, command.

I can soothe like rain,
strike like iron,
wander, stutter, sing.

Before writing, I was.
After silence, I return.

I live in mouths,
in pauses,
in the trembling before a name.

Use me carefully—
I become what you release.
